# Uninvested published11 worker-storage fixture

This disposable observer creates one real published4.7.20002 or4.7.21002 save with empty `worker-robots-storage-4` work on every force. It writes only unrelated Base work to its named foreign force: current and queued Base research, saved Base progress, one disabled Base worker-speed row and the resulting Base worker-speed modifier. The player stays idle.

The fixture is removed for the middle published5.0.11 load. That selection is exactly Base plus MIR, so published11 itself performs its actual configuration callback without this observer, without a fresh11 initialization path and without any marker deletion or insertion. The controlled server-save creates the protected published11 input.

The same0.13.0 observer is newly added only with candidate17. Its configuration callback records the actual startup-setting Boolean and projected `mod_changes` rows after MIR runs, reads public frames and refuses unless every continuation C4 remains empty. It never reads MIR storage or writes worker state before that admission. The false setting route is the fixture-addition arm; the true setting route is explicitly a mixed startup-settings-plus-fixture-addition event, not startup-only admission evidence.

The identical archive is also passive for exact candidate16 added-mod negative arms. Its init, configuration and tick handlers return without fixture storage or world writes, allowing MIR16's own missing saved-route rejection to remain the native witness. An unexpected old16 success is adverse; this fixture does not turn it into an acceptance path.

After admission, only the player receives the actor's ordinary default-C4 lab work. Its seven prerequisite rows are an explicit authored set, checked against the public default-C4 contract before each bounded scripted prerequisite operation; there is no recursive graph traversal. The foreign Base work and its independent native modifier must remain exact through the completion, save and two read-only cold processes. This fixture is not a Sage/Kal reproduction and does not establish private route-marker contents; the separate old16 negative is the native evidence that the same protected published11 source has no saved route.

Host controls validate actor boundaries and declared source/candidate tuples only. They do not build an archive, run Factorio or qualify the producer, candidate save, ordinary completion or cold reloads.
